nusmp.skill.nen.description: Ultimate. Hunter x Hunter's life energy in seventeen modes. Basics: Ten (mend and guard), Zetsu (hide and heal, the first blow is an ambush), Ren (burst of aura and power), Gyo (see and mark), En (a 12 s sense field that dodges the first blow), Ken (guard and reflect), Ko (store aura, then strike), Shu, In, Ryu. The six Hatsu are signature moves: Enhancement a rushing fist that wears armour, Emission a homing volley, Transmutation lightning / gum / rubber by stance, Conjuration chains, Manipulation a needle, Specialization a field that steals boons. Vow and Limitation boosts every Hatsu. Your Water Divination type decides how well each Hatsu works for you.
nusmp.skill.msg.nen.zetsu: Zetsu: your presence is gone and you rest. The blow that breaks it is an ambush.
nusmp.skill.msg.nen.ken: Ken: you hold your ground, and a third of every blow goes back at who struck.
nusmp.skill.msg.nen.ko: Ko: all your aura gathers in one fist. Strike now, or wait: the longer, the harder.
nusmp.skill.msg.nen.trans.electric: Transmutation: your aura turns to lightning.
nusmp.skill.msg.nen.trans.gum: Transmutation: your aura turns to gum.
nusmp.skill.msg.nen.trans.rubber: Transmutation: your aura turns to rubber.
